messages:
Maya CS: Quick sync for Callisto private deploy — they claim peering accepted but logs/KMS/IAM still outstanding. Can we list exact items we need from them and owners? TL;DR: network peering acceptance, firewall egress allowlist, KMS key policy approval, IAM role ARNs/SAML metadata, audit log S3 bucket + retention + SIEM hook. Blockers?

Eli SRE: Peering shows PENDING_ACCEPT on our console until Callisto clicks accept. I asked them for the peering ID (pcx-0a1b2c3d4e5f6) and sent a calendar ping to their netops. If not accepted by EOD, we escalate.

Ana Sec: For KMS — they want to manage their own CMK. We need a key policy that explicitly allows our ingest role to Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for log ingestion. Sample snippet below. Also need to confirm whether logs will be encrypted with that CMK or another one.

Ana Sec: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ingest"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Priya PM: Also ask Callisto to provide the exact IAM Role ARN and the SAML metadata URL — we need those for SSO and role mapping. Their IAM team was confused by our example mapping.

Jamal Support: For audit logs we need: CloudTrail -> S3 bucket name, the KMS key ARN used to encrypt that bucket, and the SIEM ingestion method (push to syslog endpoint vs. S3 pull). We also need to confirm retention (our default guidance is 365 days). If they want >365 days we should provide cost estimate.

Maya CS: They asked for a short retention policy template and a cost ballpark for 2x retention. I gave an estimate and highlighted that extended retention impacts storage + retrieval. I also noted we can accept logs via GCP Pub/Sub or S3; if Pub/Sub they need to provide a service account with Pub/Sub Subscriber role.

Eli SRE: Firewall notes — they asked for our egress IPs to allow in their ACLs. Provide approximate set (examples below); they should treat these as endpoints that can change across AZs so advise CIDR ranges where possible. Example egress IPs: 54.201.32.11, 34.72.90.5, 3.211.77.88. Health checks: outbound tcp/443 to our service endpoints.

Ana Sec: One more KMS detail: rotation. For customer-managed CMKs we do not rotate keys on their behalf. They must enable automatic rotation in AWS if desired. We only need decrypt/generate permissions; any admin privileges should be limited to their security team.

Priya PM: Action items and owners: Eli — confirm peering acceptance and publish final egress IP set by 2234568000. Ana — post approved key policy template and enumerate any custom grants needed by 2234568200. Jamal — confirm S3 bucket config (bucket name, encryption, access logs) and SIEM endpoint by 2234568300. Maya — capture onboarding doc feedback and file a small PR to docs. I'll follow up with Callisto on cost/retention questions.

Maya CS: Capture of feedback from Callisto: they said our "IAM mapping" section was slightly out of date (SAML examples); they suggested a short example mapping for OIDC as well. They liked the preflight checklist but asked for clearer examples of the minimal KMS policy. I'll add that to the PR.

Eli SRE: If peering not accepted by EOD I'll raise a support ticket (P1) and loop in Sales to help nudge netops.

Maya CS: Thanks all — I'll update this thread as owners post status. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder — onboarding checklist item #7 (audit log verification) will auto-run when we detect S3 + CMK config; please mark as passed/failed in the console after verification.
